value.rationale: The naturally defined twofold sum of a canonical even-quartic graph has a full representation spectrum determining additive collision energies, image sizes and constant-input Fourier fourth moments. The nonzero coefficient square-class dichotomy produces a sharp size gap whose direction reverses with q mod4, making a structural invariant rather than a routine finite sample. The a=0 energy and local quartic image counts are explicitly credited to prior work.
